Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the neuropeptide S receptor (CHEMBL5162). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Require canonical SMILES via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5162 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
